title: wg: tell ratchet-tree-options authors 0x000A collides with OpenMLS's legacy LastResort (openmls#2318)
description: From .4.78 (promised in openmls/openmls#2318). draft-*-ratchet-tree-options-02 §6.2 suggests extension type 0x000A for ratchet_tree_source_domains; OpenMLS (fork and upstream main, verified 2026-11-04) parses 0x000a as its legacy LastResort extension (empty struct, exact length), so a peer's non-empty source_domains fails to decode instead of passing through as unknown. Already noted on Rohan's codepoint gist 2026-11-15 (Mark OK). Held per Mark 2026-11-16 (hold all spec feedback).
